entries.title: Himeros (crater)
entries.extract: Himeros, also nicknamed the Saddle, is a large impact crater on the asteroid Eros.7°E, on Eros's eastern hemisphere. The crater is named after Himeros of Greek mythology, one of seven Erotes, attendant to Eros, and the personification of the longing for love.
